Run price tests and A/B tests on a page for as long as the person wants, and change the page per visitor: write each part of the page that changes (a price card, a headline, an offer) as a set of versions with a rule that picks one, make a tracked link for every place the page is shared so each visit says where it came from, show each visitor one version and keep showing them the same one, credit sign-ups and payments to the version each person saw, and every week read which version did best by source.
